main: ### 1. How to check the activty in Slay.one currently?
Use `/current` command to get every server activity. (matches, real player count, top players of each match, ranked search count)
### 2. How to see the chart of the peak activity of Slay.one?
Use `/peak` command to get peak activity chart of Slay.one, you can also modify a bit the chart based on your need.
### 3. How to get notified when people are playing Slay.one?
Use `/radio` command to manage the switch of radio for you, radio can work in DMs or voice channel.
### 4. How to get the recent replays of public Slay.one matches?
Use `/replay` command to view and get the recent replays of public games.
Use `/ranking` command to see all the rankings.
### 6. How to see ranked player information(scores, ranks, recent logs etc)?
Use `playerrank` to search and view ranked player information.
### 7. How to see ranked clan information(scores, ranks, recent logs etc)?
Use `playerrank` to search and view ranked clan information.
